```mermaid

    a["Standard target marker"]:::current
    b["Pois-D22 target marker"]:::prod
    a --> b
    click b "/ko/content/items/named1-target-painter/" "Pois-D22 target marker"
    c["Pois-D22 target marker prototype"]:::prod
    a --> c
    click c "/ko/content/items/named1-target-painter-pr/" "Pois-D22 target marker prototype"
    classDef current fill:#2f9e6f,stroke:#1f6f4a,color:#ffffff
    classDef prod fill:#3b6ea5,stroke:#274a75,color:#ffffff
    classDef more fill:#39445a,stroke:#54658a,color:#d5dbe8
```
